title: Stop Saying "I'm Broke": 3 Better Ways #shorts
description:
Another word for broke? When you can't pay the rent and your stuff is out on the street, you're not just broke. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Hard up: have very little money (informal)
• Strapped for cash: short of money right now
• Not a penny to your name: have no money at all (idiom)

Ever been this broke?

Clip: Cops (1922)
